data.name: Our Favorite Mortal Potter
data.detailed_description:
You are their favorite mortal potter. Uh oh.

Fire up the kiln, because you're stuck here for the next three centuries unless you can find a way out. Our Favorite Mortal Potter is a job simulation game with RPG-elements, in which you make pots with an in-depth, fully fledged pottery system! Along the way, meet quirky gods characters, expand and customize your workshop, and uncover the conspiracy keeping you locked in this liminal workshop.

Pottery System

OFMP features a completely novel pottery shaping system, built from the ground up for this game. This unlocks literally infinite options for creating, shaping, and customizing the pots you create for your customers! On top of this, you can add on accessories like handles, lids, and spouts, among others.

The Story

Trapped in a small room for three centuries isn't ideal. You have to find a way out. Luckily, you have allies in unexpected places. They say they're gods, but are they? It's time to put that to the test and fight your way out of here. The story of OFMP will further unfold as the game develops.

data.short_description: Our Favorite Mortal Potter is a job simulation game about being an abducted potter in an infinitely powerful extraterrestrial's loving keep. You are here to make them pots. They love pots. You better love pots too, because creating them is your sole purpose for the next three-hundred years.
